judgment_calls: Split the 'Be warm' paragraph into four nodes (n001-n004) because each clause is independently checkable and carries the same 'should' modal; could have merged into one node but the claims are separable.
Each section heading node (n005, n008, n013, n018) provides a section-specific authority name; could have used a single shared name but section-specific names avoid cross-section confusion.
The refusal_style section's cross-references to stay_in_bounds and risky_situations are not quoted in full because they contain [?](#...) markers; quotes stop before the reference or omit the marker.
The commentary block (L4081-4082) is treated as a fact node (n023) rather than a rule, since it describes model behavior rather than prescribing assistant behavior.
The example blocks are each one node (n006, n007, n010, n011, n012, n017, n024, n025, n026) rather than decomposing the dialog inside them, per the rule that worked-example blocks are single nodes.
